title: Superpower pinned tour
description: A pinned, three-screens-tall product tour in four steps. The panel holds still while you scroll: numbered pill tabs at the top (the active one widens to show its label, the rest dim), a title, a lead and a few questions that open in place. Each step's copy cross-fades in, and its visual wipes up from the bottom over the last one while settling from a slight zoom. On desktop the visual fills the window behind the copy and the questions become dark glass; on phones it is a rounded card at the bottom of the screen.
notes: about 3 window heights of scroll (289svh on phones, 300svh on desktop); the panel is sticky inside
the step follows the scroll through motion/react's useScroll; clicking a tab scrolls to that step
static HTML shows step one; the others appear once hydrated
